scientific_integrity: Exact all-size proof from conserved column-parity marker and one-dimensional reflector gaps; direct exhaustive C++ and separate Python checks are finite corroboration, not independent formal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only the two-row periodic oriented square-cell torus, standard binary ant, labelled full-state cycles. The column marker invariant was already noted in 2019; the 2004 one-dimensional-ant paper was available in abstract only. Historical priority is qualified.
title: Exact reflector-gap orbit census for Langton's ant on the \(2\times n\) torus
